name: laly-web
//: bun only — no pnpm/npm lockfiles. sharp is trusted so its install script runs (bun blocks lifecycle scripts by default); it was pnpm's allowBuilds entry.

scripts.//scripts: bun run generate:types, never bunx payload — the bin is #!/usr/bin/env node and registers its own TS loader for the config; bun run executes the .bin shim so the shebang is honored.
scripts.//seed: Seeds ONLY the paid-advertising doc. Home is edited in /admin — the database is its source of truth and no script writes it any more (the old seed-home.ts is in git history if a fresh database ever needs bootstrapping).
scripts.//seed:branding: Seeds ONLY the branding doc. No uploads — every image on that page is a static import.
scripts.//seed:development: Seeds ONLY the development doc. No uploads — the one image on that page is a static import.
scripts.//update:about: Reorders the home About Us team and rewrites their role lines in place. Touches only that block's members; stops without writing if the names in the doc don't match.
scripts.//update:paid-faq: Replaces ONLY the /paid-advertising FAQ rows (copy in src/lib/mock/paid-faq.ts). Other blocks untouched.
scripts.//check:slots: Self-check for the booking availability engine (src/lib/slots.ts). Plain asserts, no test framework — run it after touching business hours, slot length or the race guard.
scripts.//seed:node: Fallback runner on Node via Payload's own loader. Needed only if payload.config.ts ever imports @payloadcms/richtext-lexical again — its circular ESM deps break under bun.
